expect.why: A 270px step up, with the upper ledge set back 100px so there is no wall to clamp against on the way up. Jump rise is n*J - n*(n+1)/2 for J = 12 + 1.1*jmp, n = floor(J), doubled by Double Jump: 253px at rung 10 (jmp4+DJ) fails, 289px at rung 14 (jmp5+DJ) clears. Tolerance 1: 19px of clearance is only about six frames near the apex to cover the 40px of horizontal set-back.

handPlay.why: Played at rung 14. The step is clearable with a normal run-up, no wall-hug or corner-boost needed.
